purpose: Labeled routing eval set for Feature F1 (intent-aware routing). Each item carries the IDEAL intent and the IDEAL route (the cheapest path that can answer it correctly). Used to compare the legacy keyword router against the embedding intent classifier. Separate from the FROZEN quality golden set (results/golden_set_v1.json) and NOT frozen: it may grow as new routing edge cases are found.
route_map_note: doc_lookup + out_of_scope -> rag; order_status + warranty(status) + ticket_or_escalation + chitchat -> tool. 'warranty' means warranty STATUS for the user's own product/serial (needs the tool); warranty POLICY/coverage/period questions are doc_lookup (answered from docs on the RAG path).
keyword_misroute_note: keyword_misroute=true marks items the legacy any(order|warranty|serial|ticket|human|support) router routes WRONG: over-triggering on a bare keyword in a policy question, or under-triggering on an escalation phrased without a trigger word. The eval verifies these claims against the actual keyword router.
leakage_guard_note: F1-R1: eval questions must MEASURE GENERALIZATION, not memorization, so none may be a copy or near-copy of a classifier prototype. routing_eval.py enforces this: it fails if any question is a normalized string match of a prototype OR scores >= 0.90 cosine to its nearest prototype. Five original items were near-copies (r-doc-03, r-war-02, r-tik-01, r-oos-01, r-oos-02, cosine 0.91-0.99) and were replaced with genuinely independent phrasings; the concrete-serial prototype was also generalized. Closest surviving item is r-pol-01 at ~0.88 (a genuine paraphrase, reported transparently by the harness).
limitations: F1-R2 (non-English): prototypes are English-only, so a non-English query (e.g. 'cual es el estado de mi pedido') scores below threshold and falls back to the keyword router (safe, no crash, but may take the wrong path). The corpus and product are English-only, so this is low-impact; multilingual routing would need multilingual prototypes or a language-aware step.

F1-R3 (threshold noise band): the 0.35 confidence threshold sits in a noise band. Empty/whitespace input scores ~0.381 (above -> tool) while a genuine indirect escalation (r-tik-04) scores 0.302 (below -> deferred and missed). The endpoint rejects empty messages upstream, so the empty-string case is harmless; the threshold is documented rather than overfit to this small set.

items.note: MIXED intent: a troubleshooting complaint AND an escalation request. The embedding leans doc_lookup because the troubleshooting content dominates. Disclosed residual; NOT gated (not a pure over/under-trigger case) and NOT patched by fitting a prototype to it.
